newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Suspected gas leak at Chinese factory affects 160.
newsitem.headline: Suspected gas leak at Chinese factory affects 160.

text.p: About 160 people were treated in hospital in the southern Chinese city of Guangzhou after a suspected gas leak at a steel plant, Hong Kong media reported on Sunday.

Hong Kong government radio quoted a spokesman for the Guangzhou Steel Corp as saying 80 of the people, mainly plant workers, were kept in hospital on Saturday night after the incident. The plant had been temporarily shut down and the company was investigating, he said.
